paper: Bernardo et al., PLOS ONE 11(1):e0146349 (2016) — Piper betle extracts vs multidrug-resistant bacteria (broth microdilution MIC, CLSI M07-A8)
quoted_basis: Two-fold serial dilution of each plant extract with starting concentration of 100 mg/ml was prepared using cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth or MHB ... as diluent resulting in concentrations of 2.44 ug/ml to 10,000 ug/ml
Each set-up was carried out in triplicate in sterile 96-well microplates
Controls consisted of culture control (no plant extract), negative control (plant extract and MHB only) and reference drug controls
Ten (10) uL of the adjusted inoculum were added into each well containing 100 uL of plant extract in the dilution series, and mixed

controls.name: negative control — extract + MHB, no inoculum
